name: paligemma-blind-assist-lora-merged-v1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from google/paligemma-3b-mix-224 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8192). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: MQA: 8 query heads, 1 KV head, head_dim 256 (Gemma-2B text tower)
notes: ADDED 2026-11-07. LoRA (r8, alpha 16, 11.3M trainable = 0.385%) on google/paligemma-3b-mix-224 for VizWiz blind-assistance VQA and captioning, merged into standalone bf16 weights (seed 123), so the tensor set and 2.923B parameter count are identical to the base. Recorded as a contender because the card prints Base and LoRA columns on the same benchmark tables. Its sibling lamao-ab/paligemma-blind-assist-qlora-merged-v1 is the 4-bit QLoRA recipe and is NOT the same model: the author reports the two recipes differing by 0.09 points on VizWiz-VQA and 1.35 CIDEr-D on VizWiz-Captions test. Honest caveats recorded with the wins: gains are large on VizWiz-Captions CIDEr-D (60.17 -> 105.37) but the model LOSES general-domain accuracy (VQAv2 81.65 -> 81.15, COCO-Caps CIDEr-D 131.21 -> 124.54), and both of those losing rows are stored. 4-bit variant exists for on-device; this bf16 one OOMs on an 8 GB Jetson Orin Nano. Predictions and scorers are released, so the numbers are recomputable. Licence gemma, repo created 2026-06-27.

benchmarks.name: VizWiz-Captions test CIDEr-D
benchmarks.config: Card 'VizWiz-Captions (test)' table, base 'Base (generic prompt)' 60.17 vs LoRA 104.37 +/-1.36 (3-seed mean); 'This checkpoint' table gives 105.37 for the seed-123 merged bf16 weights. 7,974 of 8,000 test images evaluated (official eval captions cover 7,983 sets, 9 match no image). Greedy decoding, 64 new tokens.

benchmarks.name: VizWiz-VQA test overall
benchmarks.config: Card 'VizWiz-VQA (test)' table: base 73.95 (generic prompt) / 74.83 (accessibility prompt) vs LoRA 75.80 +/-0.21; 'This checkpoint' row 75.75. Official consensus metric (mean of 10 leave-one-out min(1,matches/3)). Adapted models scored with the accessibility prompt.

benchmarks.name: VizWiz-Captions validation CIDEr-D
benchmarks.config: Card 'This checkpoint' table 99.16; validation base 55.31. Validation split was used for checkpoint/rank selection, so this is not a held-out number - stored for completeness only.

benchmarks.name: VQAv2 test-standard overall
benchmarks.config: General-domain control, card table: base 81.65 vs LoRA 81.15 +/-0.04 (3-seed mean, this checkpoint's own VQAv2 not printed). Regression of 0.50 points; stored so the retained cost is visible.

benchmarks.name: COCO-Caps val2014 CIDEr-D
benchmarks.config: General-domain retention table: base 131.21 vs LoRA 124.54 +/-1.36 (3-seed mean). Card states COCO val2014 is a retention measure, not held-out (75.3% of images are restval, in the base's training data). Regression stored so the cost is visible.
